description: Fetch one or more of the site's own live page URLs to discover editable content and write it into the site's schema. Pass the page addresses in `urls`. `auto` controls whether unmarked elements are read: leave it unset to read unmarked elements only on pages with no data-tusk marks at all, true to always read unmarked elements, false to only honour explicit data-tusk marks. A first scan of a new site replaces its untouched starter content. Returns the fields found per page and what changed.

auto.description: Read unmarked elements: unset = only on pages with no data-tusk, true = always, false = never.

urls.description: Absolute page URLs to scan, e.g. ["https://suntex.com.au/","https://suntex.com.au/about"].

name: scan_site
title: Scan site
